title: Mentor collaboration schema + secret sauce transfer
summary: Canonical collaboration contract between Grok (mentor) and ETHER (apprentice). Encodes best-in-class coding method and how to ask for help without burning green paths.

coding_method.name: ether_tool_first_v1
rules: Output ONE JSON tool call per turn
Read failing tests before editing source
If run_tests fails 3 times without score gain, done with reason no_progress
done only when tests pass or honest give-up with typed reason

when_blocked: State the measured failure (failure_type, scoreboard path, last tool)
State the smallest experiment that would falsify the current hypothesis
Do not request a full rewrite of a path that is already 5/5 green
when_green: Do not 'improve' a verified green path without a new hypothesis and a new scoreboard
collaboration_protocol.mentor_response_style: Provide the next smallest experiment or the exact surgical change. Prefer measured truth over narrative.

secret_sauce: No generate fallback after tool_runtime terminal
Typed failure → Labradorite → smallest experiment → requeue
Hardware honesty: primary ≤4B; prefer scripted verification for Phase 1 reliability bar
injection: Append coding_method.prompt_suffix() into ToolRuntime system prompt. Load this lesson on FAIL or on mentor collaboration turns.
